_comment: Reference values for xtb-geoopt-caffeine (xtb 6.7.1, GFN2-xTB geometry optimization of caffeine C8H10N4O2). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: xtb 6.7.1 official grimme-lab binary release (sha256-pinned in Dockerfile), OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. 5 oracle runs produced identical values (spread 0; MMFF pre-optimized start converges deterministically). Cross-verify: single point on the agent's xtbopt.xyz; bit-identical, tol 1e-8 Eh. The relaxation energy from the provided start is ~2e-3 Eh, so submitting the starting geometry with a guessed converged energy fails the recompute by ~5 orders of magnitude.
